# Scene editor E6: notes

Step 6 of 6 of the in-game scene editor. Design page: https://claude.ai/artifact/GZf1vP9iD5ChT2cx2BGD6p. Read PROJECT-BRIEF.md first and follow its standing rules. Needs E1 to E5. No code changes in this step.

## Goal
The project's notes describe the scene editor, so a fresh chat can use and extend it.

## Build
1. `context.md`: append a section "Scene editor (E1 to E5)". Do not read context.md whole; Grep for the last heading and append after it. Cover: what it does; how to open it (Dev Mode > Open Editor); the keys; the overlay file `dist/scene-edits.js` and that only the hub's Accept writes it; the three scene routes and their origin rule; the Check button; what version 1 does not cover (interiors, generated street furniture and trees, buildings, resizing); what was not verified in a real browser, taken from the E3 to E5 run reports.
2. `brief-notes.md`: one or two lines in "State" and one in "Where to change things" (Scene edits: `scene-edit.js`, `scene-overlay.js`, `scene-editor.js`, `hub/scene.js`). The brief has a 3,000-token guard (`tests/brief.mjs`): keep the additions short and trim an older line if needed.
3. `README.md`: a short entry for the current version.
4. `DESIGN.md`: a short subsection recording the decisions: overlay file instead of editing the map, hub writes on Accept, free camera with the game paused, both Send to hub and Apply to game.
5. Run `npm test`. `npm run index` is not available to this run: say in the report that the user or the next chat must run `npm run index` afterwards, and that `tests/brief.mjs` may fail until then.

## Rules
- No BOM. Do not commit. Do not edit PROJECT-BRIEF.md or PROJECT-INDEX.md by hand (they are generated).

## Done when
The four files are updated and the report lists exactly what must be run next.

## Run
model: haiku
why: short note edits
size: S
needs: test
